params.value: Highest recall achievable while holding precision at 80%. Rationale: a pre-operative optimisation pathway loses clinical credibility when a large share of its flags are wrong. The target was set with the clinical team, cross-checked against the decision curve (7b) and against review capacity (7c); it is a service decision, not a modelling one.
Highest recall achievable while holding precision at 80%. Rationale: a pre-operative optimisation pathway loses clinical credibility below 4-in-5 flags being genuine.
